metadata.notes: Manual Copilot generation for stage-3 records; protected source fields were kept unchanged.

word_meaning.meaning_en: a grown person; fully developed or mature

word_example.example_en: Every adult must carry valid ID here.
word_example.example_zh: 这里每位成年人都必须携带有效证件。

word_example.example_en: The child wants to act like an adult.
word_example.example_zh: 那个孩子想表现得像个成年人。

word_meaning.meaning_en: to move forward or help something develop

word_example.example_en: Science can advance when ideas are shared.
word_example.example_zh: 当观点被分享时，科学会向前发展。

word_example.example_en: The soldiers could not advance in heavy rain.
word_example.example_zh: 士兵们在大雨中无法前进。

word_meaning.meaning_en: something that makes a person or thing better in a situation

word_example.example_en: Online study has one clear advantage today.
word_example.example_zh: 如今在线学习有一个明显的优势。

word_example.example_en: Her language skill gave our team advantage.
word_example.example_zh: 她的语言能力给了我们团队优势。

word_meaning.meaning_en: an exciting or unusual experience, often with risk

word_example.example_en: Their desert adventure changed both friends forever.
word_example.example_zh: 他们的沙漠冒险永远改变了两位朋友。

word_example.example_en: Camping alone felt like a real adventure.
word_example.example_zh: 独自露营感觉像一次真正的冒险。

word_meaning.meaning_en: to tell people publicly about a product or event

word_example.example_en: They advertise new phones on every screen.
word_example.example_zh: 他们在每个屏幕上为新手机做广告。

word_example.example_en: The shop advertised cheap fruit all week.
word_example.example_zh: 那家商店整个星期都在宣传廉价水果。

word_meaning.meaning_en: a public notice or message that promotes something

word_example.example_en: That advertisement used music and bright colors.
word_example.example_zh: 那则广告使用了音乐和鲜艳的颜色。

word_example.example_en: We saw an advertisement near the station.
word_example.example_zh: 我们在车站附近看到了一则广告。

word_meaning.meaning_en: an opinion or suggestion about what someone should do

word_example.example_en: My teacher gave useful advice before exams.
word_example.example_zh: 考试前我的老师给了有用的建议。

word_example.example_en: You should follow medical advice after surgery.
word_example.example_zh: 手术后你应该遵循医生的建议。

word_meaning.meaning_en: to tell someone what you think they should do

word_example.example_en: Doctors advise us to sleep on time.
word_example.example_zh: 医生建议我们按时睡觉。

word_example.example_en: I advise you to save your notes.
word_example.example_zh: 我建议你保存好笔记。

word_meaning.meaning_en: to publicly support an idea or action; a supporter

word_example.example_en: Many teachers advocate more reading at home.
word_example.example_zh: 许多老师提倡在家多阅读。

word_example.example_en: She became an advocate for clean rivers.
word_example.example_zh: 她成为了清洁河流的倡导者。

word_meaning.meaning_en: the British English word for airplane

word_example.example_en: The aeroplane crossed the clouds at dawn.
word_example.example_zh: 那架飞机在黎明时穿过云层。

word_example.example_en: He drew an aeroplane on the notebook cover.
word_example.example_zh: 他在笔记本封面上画了一架飞机。

word_meaning.meaning_en: a matter, event, or situation that someone deals with

word_example.example_en: School affairs kept her busy this month.
word_example.example_zh: 学校事务让她这个月一直很忙。

word_example.example_en: This is not my private affair alone.
word_example.example_zh: 这不只是我一个人的私事。

word_meaning.meaning_en: to influence or change someone or something

word_example.example_en: Bad weather can affect train times badly.
word_example.example_zh: 坏天气会严重影响火车时刻。

word_example.example_en: Noise often affects my focus in class.
word_example.example_zh: 噪音常常影响我上课时的专注力。

word_meaning.meaning_en: a feeling of liking or loving someone very much

word_example.example_en: The dog showed affection by licking his hand.
word_example.example_zh: 那只狗通过舔他的手表达喜爱。

word_example.example_en: Children need affection as they grow up.
word_example.example_zh: 孩子在成长过程中需要关爱。

word_meaning.meaning_en: to have enough money or time for something
word_meaning.meaning_zh: vt.负担得起（…的费用）；抽得出（时间）；提供

word_example.example_en: We cannot afford a car this year.
word_example.example_zh: 我们今年买不起汽车。

word_example.example_en: She could not afford extra study time.
word_example.example_zh: 她抽不出额外的学习时间。

word_meaning.meaning_en: feeling fear or worry

word_example.example_en: He felt afraid in the dark room.
word_example.example_zh: 他在黑暗的房间里感到害怕。

word_example.example_en: I am afraid the answer is wrong.
word_example.example_zh: 恐怕这个答案是错的。

word_meaning.meaning_en: the continent south of Europe and west of Asia

word_example.example_en: Africa is rich in wildlife and culture.
word_example.example_zh: 非洲拥有丰富的野生动物和文化。

word_example.example_en: They learned about Africa in geography class.
word_example.example_zh: 他们在地理课上学习了非洲。

word_meaning.meaning_en: from Africa; a person from Africa
word_meaning.meaning_zh: a.非洲的，非洲人的n.非洲人

word_example.example_en: African art often uses bold color and shape.
word_example.example_zh: 非洲艺术经常使用大胆的色彩和造型。

word_example.example_en: An African player joined our school team.
word_example.example_zh: 一位非洲球员加入了我们校队。

word_meaning.meaning_en: later than something else in time or order
word_meaning.meaning_zh: ad.在后；后来prep.在…之后；在后面conj.在…以后

word_example.example_en: We cleaned the room after dinner tonight.
word_example.example_zh: 今晚晚饭后我们打扫了房间。

word_example.example_en: After he arrived, the meeting began quickly.
word_example.example_zh: 他到达后，会议很快开始了。

word_meaning.meaning_en: the part of the day after noon

word_example.example_en: The warm afternoon made everyone feel sleepy.
word_example.example_zh: 温暖的午后让每个人都感到困倦。

word_example.example_en: We have art class every Thursday afternoon.
word_example.example_zh: 我们每周四下午都有美术课。

word_meaning.meaning_en: later or after that event

word_example.example_en: They argued first and laughed afterward.
word_example.example_zh: 他们先争论，后来又笑了。

word_example.example_en: I wrote the report and rested afterward.
word_example.example_zh: 我写完报告后休息了。

word_meaning.meaning_en: one more time

word_example.example_en: Please try the question again with care.
word_example.example_zh: 请认真地再做一遍这道题。

word_example.example_en: The bird sang again outside my window.
word_example.example_zh: 那只鸟又在我窗外唱了起来。

word_meaning.meaning_en: opposed to something, or touching its surface

word_example.example_en: He leaned against the tree and waited.
word_example.example_zh: 他靠着树等着。

word_example.example_en: The class voted against that strange rule.
word_example.example_zh: 全班投票反对那条奇怪的规定。

word_meaning.meaning_en: the number of years someone has lived or a period in history

word_example.example_en: At her age, she writes very well.
word_example.example_zh: 以她这个年龄来说，她写得很好。

word_example.example_en: We live in the digital age now.
word_example.example_zh: 我们如今生活在数字时代。

word_meaning.meaning_en: an organization that provides a service for others

word_example.example_en: The agency sent us the travel details.
word_example.example_zh: 那家机构把旅行细节发给了我们。

word_example.example_en: A local agency offered help after floods.
word_example.example_zh: 洪水后，一家本地机构提供了帮助。

word_meaning.meaning_en: a list of things to discuss at a meeting

word_example.example_en: The chair changed the agenda before lunch.
word_example.example_zh: 主席在午饭前修改了议程。

word_example.example_en: Please read the agenda on page one.
word_example.example_zh: 请阅读第一页上的议程。

word_meaning.meaning_en: a person who acts for another person or company

word_example.example_en: Her agent planned a careful media tour.
word_example.example_zh: 她的经纪人安排了一次周密的媒体巡访。

word_example.example_en: The travel agent found a cheaper route.
word_example.example_zh: 旅行代理找到了更便宜的路线。

word_meaning.meaning_en: violent or hostile behavior, especially in attack

word_example.example_en: The article condemned aggression against small nations.
word_example.example_zh: 那篇文章谴责了对小国的侵略。

word_example.example_en: Aggression often destroys trust and peace.
word_example.example_zh: 侵略常常破坏信任与和平。

word_meaning.meaning_en: hostile, forceful, or ready to attack

word_example.example_en: His aggressive reply surprised the whole room.
word_example.example_zh: 他咄咄逼人的回答让整个房间都吃了一惊。

word_example.example_en: The team used an aggressive attack plan.
word_example.example_zh: 这个团队采用了激进的进攻计划。

word_meaning.meaning_en: before now; in the past

word_example.example_en: We met in this town years ago.
word_example.example_zh: 我们多年前在这个镇上见过。

word_example.example_en: That bridge was built long ago.
word_example.example_zh: 那座桥很久以前就建成了。

word_meaning.meaning_en: to have the same opinion or accept a plan

word_example.example_en: I agree with your final decision today.
word_example.example_zh: 我同意你今天的最终决定。

word_example.example_en: They agreed to meet after the game.
word_example.example_zh: 他们同意在比赛后见面。

word_meaning.meaning_en: a shared decision, promise, or formal arrangement

word_example.example_en: Their agreement ended the long family dispute.
word_example.example_zh: 他们的一致意见结束了长期的家庭争执。

word_example.example_en: The two schools signed an agreement yesterday.
word_example.example_zh: 两所学校昨天签署了一项协议。

word_meaning.meaning_en: related to farming and crop production

word_example.example_en: This county is mainly an agricultural area.
word_example.example_zh: 这个县主要是一个农业地区。

word_example.example_en: Agricultural tools saved workers much time.
word_example.example_zh: 农业工具为工人节省了很多时间。

word_meaning.meaning_en: the work or science of farming

word_example.example_en: Agriculture supports many families in this region.
word_example.example_zh: 农业支撑着这个地区许多家庭的生活。

word_example.example_en: He studies agriculture at a local college.
word_example.example_zh: 他在当地大学学习农学。

word_meaning.meaning_en: in front or earlier than expected

word_example.example_en: Walk ahead and keep the gate open.
word_example.example_zh: 走在前面，并把门保持打开。

word_example.example_en: We planned ahead for the final exam.
word_example.example_zh: 我们为期末考试提前做了计划。

word_meaning.meaning_en: help or support, or to give such help

word_example.example_en: Doctors rushed to aid the injured driver.
word_example.example_zh: 医生们迅速赶去援助受伤的司机。

word_example.example_en: The village received aid after the storm.
word_example.example_zh: 暴风雨过后，这个村庄得到了援助。

word_meaning.meaning_en: a serious disease that damages the immune system

word_example.example_en: The poster explained AIDS prevention in simple words.
word_example.example_zh: 海报用简单的话解释了艾滋病预防。

word_example.example_en: Students discussed how AIDS affects public health.
word_example.example_zh: 学生们讨论了艾滋病如何影响公共健康。

word_meaning.meaning_en: a purpose or target; to direct effort or point toward something
word_meaning.meaning_zh: n.目的；目标v.计划，打算；瞄准；针对

word_example.example_en: Her aim is to study medicine later.
word_example.example_zh: 她的目标是以后学习医学。

word_example.example_en: He aimed the camera at the moon.
word_example.example_zh: 他把相机对准了月亮。

word_meaning.meaning_en: the gases around the earth that we breathe

word_example.example_en: Morning air felt cool beside the lake.
word_example.example_zh: 湖边清晨的空气感觉很凉爽。

word_example.example_en: Plants help keep the air clean.
word_example.example_zh: 植物有助于保持空气清洁。

word_meaning.meaning_en: a flying vehicle such as a plane

word_example.example_en: The aircraft left the airport on time.
word_example.example_zh: 那架飞机准时离开了机场。

word_example.example_en: Modern aircraft use advanced safety systems.
word_example.example_zh: 现代飞机使用先进的安全系统。

word_meaning.meaning_en: mail sent by plane

word_example.example_en: The airmail reached London in three days.
word_example.example_zh: 这封航空邮件三天内到了伦敦。

word_example.example_en: She chose airmail for the urgent letter.
word_example.example_zh: 她为那封紧急信件选择了航空邮件。

word_meaning.meaning_en: a plane used for flying people or goods

word_example.example_en: The airplane flew above the snowy hills.
word_example.example_zh: 飞机飞过了白雪覆盖的山丘。

word_example.example_en: Her first airplane ride felt both strange.
word_example.example_zh: 她的第一次乘飞机经历感觉有些陌生。

word_meaning.meaning_en: a place where aircraft land and take off

word_example.example_en: The airport was crowded before the holiday.
word_example.example_zh: 节日前机场十分拥挤。

word_example.example_en: We reached the airport before sunrise today.
word_example.example_zh: 今天我们在日出前赶到了机场。

word_meaning.meaning_en: the area of sky controlled by a country

word_example.example_en: The jet entered national airspace at noon.
word_example.example_zh: 那架喷气式飞机在中午进入了国家领空。

word_example.example_en: Pilots must respect each country's airspace rules.
word_example.example_zh: 飞行员必须遵守各国的空域规则。

word_meaning.meaning_en: a warning signal or the device that makes it

word_example.example_en: The fire alarm rang across the building.
word_example.example_zh: 火警警报响彻了整栋楼。

word_example.example_en: My morning alarm woke me at six.
word_example.example_zh: 我的晨间闹钟六点叫醒了我。

word_meaning.meaning_en: a book for photos or a collection of songs

word_example.example_en: Grandma keeps our photos in one album.
word_example.example_zh: 奶奶把我们的照片放在一本相册里。

word_example.example_en: His stamp album filled the whole drawer.
word_example.example_zh: 他的集邮册放满了整个抽屉。

word_meaning.meaning_en: drink or liquid containing alcohol

word_example.example_en: Young people should avoid alcohol completely.
word_example.example_zh: 年轻人应该完全避免酒精。

word_example.example_en: The doctor warned him about strong alcohol.
word_example.example_zh: 医生提醒他注意烈性酒。

word_meaning.meaning_en: containing alcohol; a person dependent on alcohol

word_example.example_en: This cake contains no alcoholic ingredient at all.
word_example.example_zh: 这个蛋糕完全不含酒精成分。

word_example.example_en: The novel describes an alcoholic seeking help.
word_example.example_zh: 这本小说描写了一位酒鬼寻求帮助。

word_meaning.meaning_en: the part of mathematics using letters and symbols

word_example.example_en: She solved the algebra problem in minutes.
word_example.example_zh: 她几分钟内就解出了这道代数题。

word_example.example_en: Algebra helps students think in patterns.
word_example.example_zh: 代数帮助学生按规律思考。

word_meaning.meaning_en: very similar; in the same way

word_example.example_en: The brothers look alike in every photo.
word_example.example_zh: 这兄弟俩在每张照片里都很像。

word_example.example_en: Parents and children suffered alike that winter.
word_example.example_zh: 那个冬天父母和孩子都一样受苦。

word_meaning.meaning_en: living, not dead; full of energy

word_example.example_en: The old tree is still alive today.
word_example.example_zh: 那棵老树今天仍然活着。

word_example.example_en: Music keeps this small town alive.
word_example.example_zh: 音乐让这个小镇充满活力。
